steps.label: Completeness DMFs per feed

bots.name: Variance Explainer
bots.tagline: Computes the volume/ARPU/mix bridge by segment and writes commentary grounded only in those numbers.

steps.label: Connections × ARPU × mix bridge by segment
steps.sql:
SELECT segment,
  (act_conn - bud_conn) * bud_arpu AS volume_eff,
  (act_arpu - bud_arpu) * act_conn AS arpu_eff,
  mix_eff
FROM SDP_VODAFONE.SNOWBOTS.V_VAM_BRIDGE WHERE fiscal_year = 2027 AND period <= '2026-10';
steps.result: YTD revenue EUR 24.61B vs EUR 25.08B budget · largest driver: Germany

steps.label: Rank top 5 drivers (|effect| ≥ EUR 10M)
steps.sql: SELECT * FROM SDP_VODAFONE.SNOWBOTS.VAM_BRIDGE_RESULT WHERE ABS(effect) >= 1e7 QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY ABS(effect) DESC) <= 5;
steps.result: 5 drivers — Germany base and price, UK integration, Türkiye indexation

steps.label: AI_COMPLETE commentary (grounded in step 3 only)
steps.result: Commentary drafted (176 words) · numeric check: 12/12 figures match bridge

steps.label: Guardrail: every number in text exists in bridge
Draft commentary to the P&L Summary + dashboard
steps.sql: INSERT INTO SDP_VODAFONE.PUBLIC.REPORT_NARRATIVE_LOG (page, text, source) VALUES ('pnl-summary', :commentary, 'SNOWBOT:variance-explainer');
steps.result: Draft published (badge: Written by Variance Explainer)

guardrails.label: Grounding
guardrails.rule: Every figure in the text must exist in the bridge result

guardrails.label: Materiality
guardrails.rule: Only drivers above threshold are explained

bots.ddl:
-- Deployable spec (not executed in demo mode)
CREATE OR REPLACE TASK SDP_VODAFONE.SNOWBOTS.T_VARIANCE_EXPLAINER
  WAREHOUSE = SDP_BOT_WH
  AFTER SDP_VODAFONE.SNOWBOTS.T_CLOSE_SENTINEL
  CONFIG = '{"autonomy": 2}'
AS
  CALL SDP_VODAFONE.SNOWBOTS.SP_RUN_BOT('variance-explainer');

-- step 1 · Close Sentinel succeeded
-- Task graph: AFTER SDP_VODAFONE.SNOWBOTS.T_CLOSE_SENTINEL
-- step 2 · Connections × ARPU × mix bridge by segment
SELECT segment,
  (act_conn - bud_conn) * bud_arpu AS volume_eff,
  (act_arpu - bud_arpu) * act_conn AS arpu_eff,
  mix_eff
FROM SDP_VODAFONE.SNOWBOTS.V_VAM_BRIDGE WHERE fiscal_year = 2027 AND period <= '2026-10';
-- step 3 · Rank top 5 drivers (|effect| ≥ EUR 10M)
SELECT * FROM SDP_VODAFONE.SNOWBOTS.VAM_BRIDGE_RESULT WHERE ABS(effect) >= 1e7 QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY ABS(effect) DESC) <= 5;
-- step 4 · AI_COMPLETE commentary (grounded in step 3 only)
SELECT AI_COMPLETE('claude-sonnet-4-5',
  'Write CFO commentary using ONLY these figures: ' || OBJECT_CONSTRUCT(*)::STRING)
FROM SDP_VODAFONE.SNOWBOTS.VAM_BRIDGE_RESULT_TOP5;
-- step 5 · Guardrail: every number in text exists in bridge
SELECT SDP_VODAFONE.SNOWBOTS.FN_NUMBERS_GROUNDED(:commentary, 'VAM_BRIDGE_RESULT_TOP5');
-- step 6 · Draft commentary to the P&L Summary + dashboard
INSERT INTO SDP_VODAFONE.PUBLIC.REPORT_NARRATIVE_LOG (page, text, source) VALUES ('pnl-summary', :commentary, 'SNOWBOT:variance-explainer');

bots.tagline: Retrains the Snowflake ML revenue forecast after close and rolls the forecast if accuracy holds.

steps.label: Retrain SNOWFLAKE.ML.FORECAST per segment
steps.result: 6 segment series retrained · 43 months of actuals

steps.label: Guardrail: backtest MAPE ≤ 2% (UK flagged)
steps.result: MAPE ≤ 1.5% for 4 segments · Türkiye 4.2% · UK 11.3% → keep planner overlay

steps.result: Nov–Mar ML EUR 17.52B vs planners EUR 17.59B (−EUR 63M)

guardrails.label: Accuracy

approval.title: Promote the ML-based rolling forecast
approval.detail: Actuals April–October + Snowflake ML November–March for Germany, Africa, Other Europe, Türkiye and Business Platforms; planner overlay kept for the UK (MAPE 11.3%). Nov–Mar EUR 17.52B vs 17.59B.

bots.ddl:
-- Deployable spec (not executed in demo mode)
CREATE OR REPLACE TASK SDP_VODAFONE.SNOWBOTS.T_ROLLING_FORECAST
  WAREHOUSE = SDP_BOT_WH
  AFTER SDP_VODAFONE.SNOWBOTS.T_CLOSE_SENTINEL
  CONFIG = '{"autonomy": 3}'
AS
  CALL SDP_VODAFONE.SNOWBOTS.SP_RUN_BOT('rolling-forecast');

-- step 1 · Close Sentinel succeeded
-- Task graph: AFTER SDP_VODAFONE.SNOWBOTS.T_CLOSE_SENTINEL
-- step 2 · Retrain SNOWFLAKE.ML.FORECAST per segment
CREATE OR REPLACE SNOWFLAKE.ML.FORECAST SDP_VODAFONE.ML.REVENUE_FORECAST_MODEL(
  INPUT_DATA => TABLE(SDP_VODAFONE.ML.REVENUE_HISTORY), SERIES_COLNAME => 'SEGMENT',
  TIMESTAMP_COLNAME => 'MONTH', TARGET_COLNAME => 'REVENUE');
-- step 3 · Guardrail: backtest MAPE ≤ 2% (UK flagged)
CALL SDP_VODAFONE.ML.REVENUE_FORECAST_MODEL!SHOW_EVALUATION_METRICS();
-- step 4 · Roll forecast: actuals Apr–Oct + ML Nov–Mar (UK overlay kept)
CALL SDP_VODAFONE.PUBLIC.SP_ROLL_FORECAST(source_version => '7+5', ml_table => 'SDP_VODAFONE.ML.ML_VS_PLAN', actual_through => '2026-10', keep_overlay => ['UK (VodafoneThree)']);
-- step 5 · Promote to current forecast (approval)
CALL SDP_VODAFONE.PUBLIC.SP_PROMOTE_VERSION('8+4 draft', approved_by => :approver);

bots.tagline: Classifies new and unmapped SAP accounts with AI_CLASSIFY; applies only high-confidence mappings.

Guardrail: confidence ≥ 0.92 auto-apply, rest to Inbox
steps.result: 6 auto-applied · 2 sent for review (integration costs → OpEx or one-off?)

steps.label: Apply mappings + DMF on unmapped balance
steps.sql: INSERT INTO SDP_VODAFONE.PUBLIC.MAP_ACCOUNT SELECT ... FROM SDP_VODAFONE.SNOWBOTS.GL_MAP_PROPOSALS WHERE confidence >= 0.92;

guardrails.rule: Any account with balance above this goes to review

approval.detail: AI_CLASSIFY proposes Support Functions — integration programme costs (confidence 0.84).

bots.ddl:
-- Deployable spec (not executed in demo mode)
CREATE OR REPLACE TASK SDP_VODAFONE.SNOWBOTS.T_GL_MAPPER
  WAREHOUSE = SDP_BOT_WH
  SCHEDULE = 'USING CRON 0 6 * * * Europe/London'
  CONFIG = '{"autonomy": 3}'
AS
  CALL SDP_VODAFONE.SNOWBOTS.SP_RUN_BOT('gl-mapper');

-- step 1 · Unmapped accounts detected
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM SDP_VODAFONE.PUBLIC.V_UNMAPPED_ACCOUNTS;
-- step 2 · AI_CLASSIFY against group COA
SELECT account_code, AI_CLASSIFY(account_name || ' ' || sample_postings,
  (SELECT ARRAY_AGG(label) FROM SDP_VODAFONE.PUBLIC.DIM_ACCOUNT WHERE is_leaf)) AS mapping
FROM SDP_VODAFONE.PUBLIC.V_UNMAPPED_ACCOUNTS;
-- step 3 · Guardrail: confidence ≥ 0.92 auto-apply, rest to Inbox
SELECT * FROM SDP_VODAFONE.SNOWBOTS.GL_MAP_PROPOSALS WHERE confidence < 0.92;
-- step 4 · Apply mappings + DMF on unmapped balance
INSERT INTO SDP_VODAFONE.PUBLIC.MAP_ACCOUNT SELECT ... FROM SDP_VODAFONE.SNOWBOTS.GL_MAP_PROPOSALS WHERE confidence >= 0.92;
